image_dimensions: 100/100 image files decoded with macOS ImageIO; all boxes align with source annotation dimensions
visual_review: All 100 source images reviewed in contact sheets. All show genuine Japanese receipts. Source dataset includes selective black bars over personal/member/payment identifiers. Store information, public addresses/phone numbers, QR codes and transaction/receipt numbers may remain. No identifiable faces were observed in the contact-sheet review.

preparation.archive_integrity: ZIP CRC valid; 105 safe paths; each packaged file matches external SHA-256 inventory; CSV/JSONL each have 100 aligned records

student_use: OCR candidate extraction for school festival or club expense entry; a human verifies every result against the source receipt. Not suitable for automated payment, accounting decisions, or exhaustive OCR accuracy claims.
limitations: PII masking is selective, not a full anonymization guarantee.
QR codes, public store contact information, and transaction identifiers can remain.
Only selected regions have transcriptions; this is not a complete OCR ground-truth corpus.
100 images are an evaluation subset selected from the 1,010-image basic dataset, not 100 additional samples.
